verdict.rationale: A public register portal holds and publishes company data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI-model training. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training, opt-outs, or data-use restrictions. It covers only public register search, publication services, invoice email authentication, and load notes, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
